subject: Throughput & procurement gateplan — clarifying latency/cost/hosting asks
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Walker <emma.walker@brightheal.com>; Luke Harper <luke.harper@brightheal.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput & procurement gateplan — clarifying latency/cost/hosting asks

Hi Emma / Luke — thanks again for the demo today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and can surface the procurement/legal asks for your internal teams.

TL;DR: we heard the primary decision criteria are (1) latency envelope (p95), (2) per-inference unit economics, and (3) hosting/compliance model (Dedicated vs Private VPC). We can meet Strong SLOs and provide SOC2 evidence; below are the specific questions we need you to confirm so we can pull together the right artifacts and a scoped pricing/host plan.

Open items for BrightHeal:
- Latency target: please confirm target p95 for user-facing generation (ms) and acceptable tail for peak windows. We heard "sub-second for short prompts, ~1200ms p95 for multimodal flows" in the call — want this recorded formally.
- Cost envelope: rough budget guidance (e.g., $ / 1M tokens or monthly committed budget) so I can produce a Dedicated vs Hosted cost comparison.
- Deployment preference: do you require Private (VPC) deployment, Reserved Dedicated capacity, or is Hosted with contractual data controls acceptable?
- Procurement & legal contacts: who will own the SOW/DPA review? Carlos or Jane? Please share emails and procurement timing.
- Security evidence: confirmation that SOC2 Type II and encryption at rest/transport are required. Any additional certifications?

Next steps I propose (I'll action after your replies):
1) Share a one-page SLA + hosting options (attached: redwood-sla-outline-1p.pdf).
2) Share SOC2 summary + expected DPA template (attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
3) Schedule a 30-min procurement sync next week with your procurement and our legal/solutions leads to align contract gates and procurement timeline.

If you prefer I convert these into a mutual action plan (timeline + owners) and drop into HubSpot, I can do that immediately after you confirm the internal names.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Walker <emma.walker@brightheal.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Luke Harper <luke.harper@brightheal.com>, Carlos Mendez <procurement@brightheal.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput & procurement gateplan — clarifying latency/cost/hosting asks

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. Couple of confirmations from our side:

- Latency: target p95 for core triage generation is 1.2s (1200ms). For short lookups we want <500ms where possible; we understand there may be variance during spikes.
- Cost: initial procurement budget target is ~$6k-$8k / month for pilot (expected ~50k monthly inference tokens). If Dedicated shows material savings at scale we'll evaluate committed capacity.
- Deployment: security wants Private VPC if we go beyond pilot. For pilot we can do Hosted with strict data controls and contractual assurances.
- Procurement lead: Carlos Mendez (procurement@brightheal.com) will handle contracting; legal reviewer is Luke Harper.
- Security: SOC2 Type II and encryption-at-rest/transport mandatory; please include key-management options (customer-managed KMS) in your materials.

Carlos — looping you in for timing. We are aiming for procurement gate review the week of 24 May.

Thanks,
Emma
Director Product, BrightHeal
emma.walker@brightheal.com

From: Carlos Mendez <procurement@brightheal.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Luke Harper <luke.harper@brightheal.com>, Emma Walker <emma.walker@brightheal.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput & procurement gateplan — clarifying latency/cost/hosting asks

Rishi — procurement checklist / asks to prepare for our internal review: 

1) SOC2 Type II attestation or SOC2 summary (PDF).
2) Draft DPA + data handling addendum (we will share a redline template).
3) Encryption: confirm AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, and whether customer-managed KMS is available (yes/no + brief flow).
4) Logging & retention: what logs are available (request/response traces, redaction options) and retention windows; we need a standard 13-month retention policy or a contractual option.
5) SLA: uptime SLA and p95 token latency SLOs for the selected deployment mode.
6) Billing: invoice terms (Net30/Net45), PO requirements, and whether we can do monthly invoices for pilot.

Please attach the SOC2 and the SLA one-pager. Also, if you have a short DPA template we can ingest and redline, please send it to procurement@brightheal.com. Once we have these, procurement will slot a review on 24 May.

Regards,
Carlos Mendez
Procurement Manager, BrightHeal
procurement@brightheal.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <procurement@brightheal.com>, Emma Walker <emma.walker@brightheal.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput & procurement gateplan — clarifying latency/cost/hosting asks

Carlos / Emma — thanks, appreciated. Quick responses and attachments below: we are attaching the SOC2 summary and the SLA one-pager you requested (same files referenced in the original email).

- SOC2: attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summarizes scope and most recent Type II window). Full attestation available under NDA; happy to provide to legal.
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA template for your team to review. If you prefer to send your redline first I can have our legal respond within 48 hours.
- Encryption/KMS: customer-managed KMS supported for Private deployments and Dedicated; Hosted can be configured with our managed KMS and encryption-in-transit. I included a short KMS flow in the SLA doc.
- Logs & retention: we can provide request/response logs with redaction and a contractual retention window; standard is 13 months but we can negotiate.
- SLA & latency: for Dedicated/Dedicated+cache we can commit to a p95 latency target aligned to 1.2s for your typical prompt distribution; Hosted pilot SLOs are documented in the SLA one-pager with fallback policies.
- Billing: Net30 invoicing available for pilot. PO accepted.

Proposed next step: Neha (cc'd) from Solutions will run a 30-min technical handoff with Luke + Emma on Thurs May 20 at 11:00am PT to walk the hosting options and confirm p95 test plan. Carlos — if you want procurement-only items earlier we can schedule a 15-min slot.

I will also drop a Mutual Action Plan into the HubSpot deal after this thread so owners/timelines are visible.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; redwood-sla-outline-1p.pdf; redwood-dpa-template.docx
